tests.name: Repository verification
tests.command: gh repo view; branch protection API; git diff --check
tests.evidence: Private, ADMIN, default main confirmed. Protection API 403 captured; explicit plan supplied. Platform typecheck/build invoke zero packages (scaffold only).

tests.name: Independent repository foundation review
tests.evidence: Independent reviewer found no scope, security, permissions, or configuration finding. The protection payload does not invent required checks; docs accurately state that main protection is not enabled and the API is blocked by the private-repository plan.

tests.name: Independent scaffold QA
tests.command: pnpm typecheck; pnpm build; git diff --check; scope inspection
tests.evidence: Independent QA at exact head: typecheck/build exit 0 but Turbo executed zero tasks because the scaffold has zero packages; diff check clean and no app/provider runtime. Environment had Node 24.21 and pnpm 11.19 although the repo pins pnpm 10.34.6.

risks: Main protection remains disabled until an owner resolves the private-repository plan limitation
Local scaffold checks provide no application package coverage
followups: Human decision on branch protection/plan if protection is required before merging foundational PRs
reviewer_instructions: Check acceptance criteria against pinned research task
Do not treat local checks as independent approval
